'''Alfred Dong San Jose Profit Deck''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Alfred Dong]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls110.htm San Jose Profit Deck], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228015339/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls110.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alfred Dong]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
